text:
alex: seeing a spike of 502/504s from hosted-api eu1 since 10:22, multiple customer embed jobs failing. sample trace ids: trace-3fa1, trace-3fa2. any idea?

maria: yup noticed too, looks like a keepalive slot exhaustion at the edge. long-lived embed uploads holding sockets open.

samir: do we have envoy/nginx upstream reset logs? what are the exact upstream errors?

sre-bot: ALERT: hosted-api-eu1 edge 502_rate +120% over 5m. top upstream error: "upstream reset" and "stream timeout".

alex: pasted a couple lines from the edge logs: 
```
[2026-02-17T10:22:13Z] envoy upstream reset: connection failure to 10.42.9.12:443 id=trace-3fa1
[2026-02-17T10:22:14Z] nginx: 504 upstream timed out while reading response header from upstream
```

maria: also seeing auth backend call QPS spike at the same time. customer is using big-batch embeddings (chunks ~8MB) with long client streaming windows. long inflight requests -> auth cache misses + backend calls -> auth backend latency amplifies.

support-ops: can you share a minimal curl repro? we should try to reproduce locally against staging frontdoor.

alex: quick repro we used (staging):
```
curl -N -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://staging-hostedapi.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -d '{"input": "<big-chunk>"}'
```
It holds the connection open while streaming chunks for ~45s.

samir: that long stream eats keepalive slots on the frontdoor. combined with auth cache TTL set to 60s and token rotation at ~50s, we get auth-cache-miss storms. auth backend latency ~200-500ms -> upstreams exceed proxy read timeout -> 504.

maria: mitigation options: (1) bump edge keepalive pool for embed route, (2) shorten idle stream timeout for guest embed flows, (3) increase auth cache TTL slightly or make token rotation less aggressive for long streams, (4) route large-embed traffic to dedicated nodes.

support-ops: rollout plan: patch edge config to increase per-route connection limit by +20 and lower streaming idle timeout from 120s -> 60s as a short-term. we'll also add a guard to reject single-chunk >6MB with 413 for guests.

alex: for immediate mitigation I wired a temporary route rule to send embed-heavy tenant to dedicated pool — saw error-rate drop in 10m.

samir: collect traces for the window: need envoy x-envoy-attempt-count, client socket age, and auth backend latency histograms. please attach one example trace to the support ticket.

maria: i'll open a config change PR with suggested timeouts + auth cache tweak and a runbook entry for this exact pattern.

support-ops: noted, add postmortem if we hit >3% customer error rate for 1hr.

alex: thanks — i'll post the PR link and attach trace-3fa1/3fa2. :thumbsup:
